sam: Quick heads-up: scheduling a pen-test dry-run next Thu. Need owners for RBAC snapshot/diff, KMS readroom (no key exports), audit-log sampling, and an oncall for the window.
laura: I'll take RBAC snapshot + diff + deny-tests. Will add post-access rotation steps. ETA Tue EOD.
andre: I'll own KMS readroom. Plan: KMS Grant for Decrypt + ephemeral IAM role; no HSM/key material export. Will add revoke steps.
tia: Logs: full fidelity for auth/KMS events, 1-in-20 sampling for app events. CloudTrail tags required. Retain auth logs 90d hot/365d archive.
mike: I can be oncall for the dry-run. Ready to run smoke checks and trigger revoke flow if needed.
dev-ops-bot: kms-proxy deploy job created: https://ci.internal/jobs/9901 - proxy will set session_tag=assessor_session and ttl=3600
sam: Action recap: laura=RBAC diff + rotate; andre=KMS grant + revoke runbook; tia=audit sampling + example CloudTrail query; mike=oncall. Sync Monday 09:30 to validate artifacts. :thumbsup:
